description: Raspberry Pi Zero 1.3 preferred; Pi Zero W or Pi Zero 2 W development variants
notes: High-assurance builds must use wireless-free hardware or disable/mitigate wireless before signing.
No persistent signing secret may be stored on boot media.
Used only for offline nSealr request QR capture.

description: Waveshare 1.3 inch LCD HAT or SeedSigner-compatible ST7789 240x240 SPI display
notes: Must show raw kind created_at author content tags request id and approval_digest.

description: SeedSigner-compatible physical approve control from HAT GPIO buttons
notes: Must be tactile and distinct from reject.

description: SeedSigner-compatible physical reject control from HAT GPIO buttons
notes: Must be tactile and distinct from approve.

description: SeedSigner-compatible navigation controls from HAT joystick/buttons
notes: Required for paging or scrolling complete content and tags before approval.

description: 5 V power source or battery pack
notes: Should support offline operation without network peripherals attached.

description: USB power cable or temporary maintenance cable
notes: Not a signing transport in the stateless QR vault flow.

description: Temporary setup keyboard serial console or debug adapter
notes: Must be removed or disabled for high-assurance signing sessions.
Must align camera display and physical controls for repeatable offline use.
May be a wireless-free board variant physical disablement or documented OS-level disablement with acceptance evidence.
